items.claim: CFO 給 FY27 營收財測：成長 15% 至 111.5 億美元（中點）
items.quote: We expect to grow revenue 15% to $11.15 billion
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY27 營業利益率擴張 250 bp 至 44%（中點）
items.quote: expand operating margin 250 basis points to 44%
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY27 EPS 財測 19.08 美元（中點）
items.quote: to grow EPS even faster at '27 to $19.08
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY27 自由現金流約 31 億美元
items.quote: free cash flow will be approximately $3.1 billion
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY26 營收預期 97 億美元
items.quote: for '26, we anticipate revenue of $9.7 billion
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 長期成長展望：2030 前整體年複合成長率中高個位數（mid-teens），先前為雙位數
items.quote: the long-term growth outlook is mid-teens CAGR through 2030
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 長期目標上調 IP 成長：由 mid-teens 到 high teens
items.quote: from the mid-teens to high teens for IP
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 長期目標上調 EDA 成長：由雙位數到 mid-teens
items.quote: from double-digit to mid-teens growth
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 各業務長期成長下限：EDA 13%
items.quote: mid-teens growth for EDA with a floor of 13%
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 各業務長期成長下限：模擬與分析（S&A）10%
items.quote: double-digit S&A growth with a floor of 10%
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 各業務長期成長下限：設計 IP 17%
items.quote: design IP with a floor of 17%
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: S&A 長期雙位數成長為有機成長，高於 ANSYS 獨立時的有機表現
items.quote: the long-term double-digit growth, that's organic
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: EPS 與自由現金流長期以 mid-20s 成長
items.quote: we will grow EPS and free cash in the mid-20s
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: AoIP 2030 年營收目標 10 億美元，管理層稱以現有合約為依據
items.quote: The projected growth for AoIP by 2030 will be $1 billion
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: FY27 沒有版稅收入，版稅自 FY28 起才進入
items.quote: There's specifically no royalty in 2027
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY27 營收財測在 9 月提前公布（原本 12 月）
items.quote: FY '27 outlook at 15% year-over-year growth
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: FY26 全年營業利益率預期 41.5%
items.quote: our expectation for full year '26 is 41.5%
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY26 較 FY25 營業利益率改善 420 bp
items.quote: 420 basis points improvement from fiscal year 2025
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 長期營業利益率目標約 50%（FY2030）
items.quote: approximately 50% by fiscal year 2030
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 50% 目標高於先前的 mid-40s 預期
items.quote: That's up from our prior expectation of mid-40s
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: CFO 說明版稅被視為近乎全額利潤，是新的利潤率槓桿
items.quote: the royalty as being 100% pure margin over time
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 回答 AI 對毛利率影響：與客戶合作時成本不變
items.quote: our cost doesn't really change
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 營業利益率目標已含投入 AoIP 工廠的成本
items.quote: does include investing in AIOP (sic) [ AOIP ]
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: CEO 表示不會為了把利潤率從 44% 推到 45–46% 而犧牲成長機會
items.quote: We will not trade off growth opportunities
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: FY27 起報告口徑改變：半導體事業單位自 ANSYS 移入 EDA（約佔 ANSYS 營收 10%）
items.quote: move the semiconductor business unit from ANSYS
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: AoIP 三層收費：授權費、客製化費（非 NRE）、版稅
items.quote: you see here it's different than an NRE
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 成本綜效 4 億美元提前一年於 FY27 完成
items.quote: $400 million run rate synergies in fiscal year 2027
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: FY27 結束時營收綜效年化超過 1 億美元
items.quote: greater than $100 million run rate in revenue synergies
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 維持營收綜效 2029 年達 4 億美元年化的承諾
items.quote: achieve the $400 million run rate synergies by 2029
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: AoIP 目標為版稅營收大於授權營收
items.quote: royalty revenue is greater than the license revenue
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: CEO 回應版稅爬坡期營收是否下滑：不會下滑
items.quote: there is no dip
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: FY27 預期出現 AI 營收
items.quote: for FY '27, we will see revenue from AI
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 2027 起 ANSYS 與 Synopsys 整合的多物理融合產品開始貢獻營收綜效
items.quote: In 2027, we will see revenue synergy from that first wave
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: CEO 收尾承諾
items.quote: we do what we say and say what we do
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 股東回報框架：最多將自由現金流的 50% 還給股東
items.quote: return up to 50% of free cash flow to shareholders
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 宣布未來數月內回購 10 億美元股票
items.quote: intent to repurchase $1 billion in Synopsys shares
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 股權報酬（SBC）佔營收比目標 FY2030 降至 8%
items.quote: targeting 8% SBC as a percent of revenue by fiscal year 2030
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: 優先順序之一：維持投資等級評等，已提前還清定期貸款
items.quote: pay off the term loans early
items.speaker: Shelagh Glaser

items.claim: AoIP（原稱 Factory 2）：與客戶早期共同定義系統並共同設計 IP；Factory 1 持續投資
items.quote: We'll continue investing in this factory
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 亞馬遜協議的 10 億美元為授權費，涵蓋三款晶片的多世代
items.quote: The $1 billion is a license fee
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 版稅時程：設計到量產約 14 個月後才開始放量
items.quote: 14-ish months of design to tape out and production
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 下一代 ZeBu 硬體系統代號 Artemis，預計 FY27 上半年
items.quote: first half of '27, the code name is Artemis
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 宣布與 OpenAI 多年合作，推出以 Synopsys 工具後訓練的 GPT-Synopsys
items.quote: a partnership multiyear with Synopsys and OpenAI
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: CEO 說明 GPT-Synopsys 後訓練成本由 OpenAI 負擔
items.quote: OpenAI will have to invest hundreds of millions of dollars
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 第三種模式的營收與 OpenAI 分成，依成果計價
items.quote: revenue share split between us and OpenAI
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: Agent 工程師平台使 VCS／Verdi 授權使用量增加的示例
items.quote: 5 to 10x more VCS and Verdi licenses
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: AI 代理工程師已與頂尖客戶展開 50 個以上合作
items.quote: Over 50 engagements with all the top customers
items.speaker: Shankar Krishnamoorthy

items.claim: 目前客戶 AI 合作多落在第二種模式（客戶自建平台＋買 Synopsys 代理），其次全堆疊，再其次前沿模型
items.quote: most of our customer engagements are in 2, then 1, then 3
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: CEO 回應「AI 模型可取代 EDA」的外界推論
items.quote: extrapolation cannot be more far off than reality
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 回答 AI 是否能繞過 EDA：否
items.quote: not be a point where you can bypass EDA completely
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 客戶對 AI 的立場摘要語
items.quote: In AI, we believe, but in physics, we trust.
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: CEO 提到投資人曾反覆詢問 Intel 流失問題，並回應 Synopsys 與 Intel 持續合作
items.quote: You've lost Intel. Are you at Intel?
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: CEO 論述 IP 在晶圓代工中的必要性
items.quote: be in the foundry business without having Synopsys IP
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 中國市場 IP 需求放緩，原因為先進製程受限
items.quote: the China opportunity as it relates to IP has slowed down
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 客戶在續約時不願簽 3 年固定容量，因為尚不知需多少容量
items.quote: not going to commit for 3 years at a certain level
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: 現階段客戶仍偏好訂閱制而非用量計費
items.quote: primarily the customer comfort zone is subscription
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

items.claim: ANSYS 併購使客戶基數擴大 10 倍
items.quote: expanded the Synopsys customer base by 10x
items.speaker: Sassine Ghazi

qa_flags.question: Jay Vleeschhouwer：核心 EDA 近年低至中個位數成長、甚至有季減，如何達到 mid-teens？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 以續約洽談中客戶要更多 AI 容量與多物理融合為由，稱 FY27 為由下而上推估且信心高，未回應核心 EDA 單獨的成長數字或所需增量

qa_flags.question: Vivek Arya：請量化明年及 2030 模型中的版稅金額
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 稱 FY27 無版稅、AoIP 10 億含授權與版稅，並表示 We didn't give a split，未給比例

qa_flags.question: Jason Celino：若替代方案的成果比 GPT-Synopsys 更好，客戶仍會付費嗎？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 轉談三種客戶選擇與工具需求，未直接回答成果較差時是否付費

qa_flags.question: Joshua Tilton：Factory 2 後續客戶管線為何；OpenAI 合作是否對 Synopsys 獨家
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 未給管線規模，稱對話進行中；獨家性問題回稱不偏袒、其他模型商是否跟進由對方決定
